name: Ernest Troubridge
bio: Royal Navy officer, later Admiral Sir Ernest Troubridge, who in October 1908 married Una Taylor as his second wife; their daughter Andrea was born in 1910. She met Radclyffe Hall in 1915 and by 1919 the Troubridges were legally separated because of it - the same year his knighthood made her Lady Troubridge. The marriage ended in law only with his death in 1926, and she kept the title until her own in 1963.
bio_note: The wedding day is deliberately not narrowed: Wikipedia and the Ransom Center both give only 'October 1908', and although Wikidata sharpens it to 10 October, its two references are an online genealogy network and a library blog post - neither a register entry - so the day is left open.
